		function decryptCharcode(n,start,end,offset) {
			n = n + offset;
			if (offset > 0 && n > end) {
				n = start + (n - end - 1);
			} else if (offset < 0 && n < start) {

		function decryptString(enc,offset) {
			var dec = "";

				var n = enc.charCodeAt(i);

					dec += decryptCharcode(n,0x2B,0x3A,offset);	/* 0-9 . , - + / : */

					dec += enc.charAt(i);

Advanced threat defense

ESET LiveGuard Advanced

Provides proactive cloud-based prevention against ransomware or never-before-seen threat types with autonomous remediation capabilities.

Future-proof your organization's
IT security with:

  • Advanced unpacking & scanning
  • Cutting-edge artificial intelligence
  • Cloud-based sandboxing
  • In-depth behavioral analysis


Enabled for ESET modules:

  • Modern Endpoint Protection
  • Server Security
  • Mail Security
  • Cloud App Protection

Explore features

Ransomware and zero-day threat detection

ESET LiveGuard Advanced uses four separate detection layers to maximize detections. Samples first undergo static analysis and state-of-the-art unpacking, and are matched against an enriched threat database. The second layer performs static and dynamic analysis, using artificial intelligence algorithms and techniques that include deep learning. Samples are then detonated in sophisticated sandboxes that monitor any signs of malicious behavior. Finally, all sandbox outputs are subjected to in-depth behavioral analysis to identify known malicious patterns and actions.

Granular reports

An admin can create a report from ESET LiveGuard Advanced data in the ESET PROTECT console. They can either use one of the pre-defined reports or make a custom one.

Transparent, full visibility

Every analyzed sample status is visible in the ESET PROTECT console, showing data sent to ESET LiveGrid®. For privacy, you can also require immediate post-analysis deletion of samples.

Automatic protection

The endpoint or server product automatically decides whether a sample is good, bad or unknown. If the sample is unknown, it is sent to ESET LiveGuard Advanced for analysis. Once the analysis is finished, the result is shared, and the endpoint products respond accordingly.

Mail Security protection

Not only does ESET LiveGuard Advanced work with files, but it also works directly with ESET Mail Security, to ensure that malicious emails are not delivered to your organization.

Mobility

Nowadays, employees often do not work on the premises. Our advanced threat defense analyzes files no matter where users are.

Proactive protection

If a sample is found to be suspicious, it is blocked from executing, pending analysis by ESET LiveGuard Advanced. Upon detection, all endpoints in the network are protected within minutes.

Tailored customization

ESET allows per-computer detailed policy configuration for ESET LiveGuard Advanced so the admin can control what is sent and what should happen based on the receiving result.

Manual submission

At any time, a user or admin can submit samples via an ESET compatible product for analysis and get the full result. Admins will see who sent what and what the result was directly in the ESET PROTECT console.

How our advanced, multilayered analysis works

ESET LiveGuard Advanced is a cloud-based threat defense solution that executes all submitted suspicious samples in an isolated ESET HQ cloud test environment and evaluates their behavior using threat intelligence feeds, multiple internal tools for static and dynamic analysis, and reputation data to detect zero-day threats. Four layers are used to analyze samples, but not all of these have to be used if we’re sure about the result in advance.

System requirements

Prerequisites for proper functioning:

  • A working ESET PROTECT Hub account
  • A supported ESET management console
  • Version 7.x or later of compatible ESET security products installed
  • A valid subscription for ESET LiveGuard Advanced
  • Activated Security products with ESET LiveGuard Advanced Subscription
  • ESET LiveGuard Advanced enabled in policies for compatible Security products
  • Access to ESET LiveGuard Advanced online servers

  • ESET Server Security for Windows Server

</h4></a></span><div class="content" id="content-pane-10851042" aria-labelledby="trigger-10851042" role="region"><div class="content-wrapper"><div id="content-c10851041" class="frame frame-default frame-type-text frame-layout-0 skin-mb-small"><p>Absolutely. If you want to see our ESET PROTECT Platform solutions in action, see our <a href="/us/business/demo/">demo</a> and <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e1OjMLSq5Qg" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">YouTube video</a> showing how to set up ESET PROTECT Cloud and deploy an ESET security product.</p><p>No installation is needed and you can experience first-hand how your cloud management will look after a few weeks of use.</p><p>If you are more interested in testing the full-feature subscription, please <a href="/us/business/try-before-you-buy/">request a free trial.</a> You can install and deploy our protection solutions and test them free for 30 days, without any commitment. If you are interested, our experienced country-based teams will contact you and discuss any additional questions or specific business requirements you might have.</p></div></div></div></div><div id="content-c10851045" class="pane "><span class="title"><a href="/us/business/small-and-medium/#cloud-or-on-prem-deployment-of-eset-protect-platform" id="trigger-10851045" class="" aria-controls="content-pane-10851045"><h4 class="bold"> Cloud or On-prem deployment of ESET PROTECT Platform? </h4></a></span><div class="content" id="content-pane-10851045" aria-labelledby="trigger-10851045" role="region"><div class="content-wrapper"><div id="content-c10851043" class="frame frame-default frame-type-text frame-layout-0 skin-mb-small"><p>ESET PROTECT Platform provides freedom of choice for both cloud and on-prem deployments. The widest range of benefits is provided via cloud deployments.<br><br>Cloud deployment enables anywhere / anytime access to all company cybersecurity data via any online connected device. It will be able to connect and report, without the need to resolve networking issues, e.g. VPNs. Compared to on-prem deployment, cloud deployment provides always up-to-date, secured information. The environment is maintained by ESET, relieving your IT department to focus on your core business. Cloud deployment of ESET PROTECT solution tiers puts ESET PROTECT Platform’s full potential at your fingertips.</p></div></div></div></div><div id="content-c10851047" class="pane "><span class="title"><a href="/us/business/small-and-medium/#when-should-i-consider-purchasing-add-on" id="trigger-10851047" class="" aria-controls="content-pane-10851047"><h4 class="bold"> When should I consider purchasing add-on? </h4></a></span><div class="content" id="content-pane-10851047" aria-labelledby="trigger-10851047" role="region"><div class="content-wrapper"><div id="content-c10851046" class="frame frame-default frame-type-text frame-layout-0"><p>ESET provides several tiers of subscriptions (packages) to the ESET PROTECT Platform with capabilities included based on your needs and level of protection required.</p><p>An add-on is useful and efficient to purchase in case of a specific demand or area to cover, when you do not necessarily need a higher-tier subscription (package) with all modules included. E.g. If you want to extend the data security just by adding a multi-factor authentication protection layer you can purchase ESET Secure Authentication as an add-on module without the need to purchase the whole ESET PROTECT Elite subscription tier.</p><p>However, we suggest you always compare and consider the benefits of purchasing an add-on solution versus buying a full subscription package that usually comes with better value for the price offered. <a href="/us/business/contact-sales/">Contact our sales experts</a> who will guide you through our offering and prepare an offer tailored to your needs.</p></div></div></div></div><div id="content-c10851049" class="pane "><span class="title"><a href="/us/business/small-and-medium/#i-want-to-protect-my-mobile-devices-how-should-i-proceed" id="trigger-10851049" class="" aria-controls="content-pane-10851049"><h4 class="bold"> I want to protect my mobile devices. How should I proceed? </h4></a></span><div class="content" id="content-pane-10851049" aria-labelledby="trigger-10851049" role="region"><div class="content-wrapper"><div id="content-c10851048" class="frame frame-default frame-type-text frame-layout-0"><p>If you want to protect only your mobile devices, purchase <a href="/us/business/solutions/mobile-threat-defense/">ESET Mobile Threat Defense</a> add-on solution and enroll all your Android, iOS or iPad OS devices via ESET PROTECT Platform. But if you need combined protection for desktop and mobile devices, you better purchase any of the ESET PROTECT subscriptions where protection of mobile devices is included by default. In the subscriptions starting from <a href="/us/business/advanced-protection/">ESET PROTECT Advanced</a> you have an extra benefit of having Mobile Threat Defense included with 1:1 ratio, that means if you buy 100 seat subscription to the ESET PROTECT Advanced solution, you get protection for 100 endpoints (and you can choose if you use it for laptops, PCs or mobiles) + extra protection for 100 mobile devices on top.</p></div></div></div></div><div id="content-c10851051" class="pane "><span class="title"><a href="/us/business/small-and-medium/#is-eset-protect-entry-sufficient-to-keep-me-safe" id="trigger-10851051" class="" aria-controls="content-pane-10851051"><h4 class="bold"> Is ESET PROTECT Entry sufficient to keep me safe? </h4></a></span><div class="content" id="content-pane-10851051" aria-labelledby="trigger-10851051" role="region"><div class="content-wrapper"><div id="content-c10851050" class="frame frame-default frame-type-text frame-layout-0 skin-mb-small"><p>ESET PROTECT Entry is a tier that provides an essential level of protection with proven and very effective prevention layer over your endpoints including <a href="/us/home/antivirus/">next-generation antivirus</a>, device control, anti-phishing and much more. Compared to other vendors, our entry solution offers not just great malware prevention (<a href="/us/business/why-eset/industry-analysts-recognition/">see our results in tests</a>) but also includes other additional features such as Device control, Anti-phishing and more, that can be greatly utilized by organizations of all sizes to <a href="/us/business/solutions/endpoint-protection/">keep your business safe</a>.</p></div></div></div></div><div id="content-c10851053" class="pane "><span class="title"><a href="/us/business/small-and-medium/#i-am-concerned-about-email-threats-what-solution-should-i-choose" id="trigger-10851053" class="" aria-controls="content-pane-10851053"><h4 class="bold"> I am concerned about email threats. What solution should I choose? </h4></a></span><div class="content" id="content-pane-10851053" aria-labelledby="trigger-10851053" role="region"><div class="content-wrapper"><div id="content-c10851052" class="frame frame-default frame-type-text frame-layout-0 skin-mb-small"><p>The smartest and the most effective option is to go for <a href="/us/business/complete-protection/">ESET PROTECT Complete</a> subscription tier with both on-prem mail security for Exchange or IBM servers and cloud app protection for Exchange Online (Microsoft 365) or Gmail (Google Workspace) included. This solution provides an extra layer of mail protection with advanced threat defense technology embedded. However, our core NGAV module Endpoint Security also includes features such as Anti-phishing that help preventing attacks from the email threat vector. And this module is included from the entry level subscription <a href="/us/business/entry-protection/">ESET PROTECT Entry.</a></p></div></div></div></div><div id="content-c10851055" class="pane "><span class="title"><a href="/us/business/small-and-medium/#is-there-any-free-support-included" id="trigger-10851055" class="" aria-controls="content-pane-10851055"><h4 class="bold"> Is there any free support included? </h4></a></span><div class="content" id="content-pane-10851055" aria-labelledby="trigger-10851055" role="region"><div class="content-wrapper"><div id="content-c10851054" class="frame frame-default frame-type-text frame-layout-0 skin-mb-small"><p>Yes, ESET has <a href="https://go.eset.com/contact-support/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">free technical support</a> for our business customers included to help with troubleshooting of the deployed ESET solutions. Within the free support we provide best effort response times during standard business hours and working week. To achieve full 24/7 instant tech support and services like e.g. health check, ESET provides additional paid <a href="/us/business/services/premium-support/">Premium Support</a> services.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="col col-sm-6 "><div id="content-c10851069" class="frame frame-default"><div data-module="ui/tabs" id="eset" class="tabs skin-accordion " ><div class="panes"><div id="content-c10851058" class="pane "><span class="title"><a href="/us/business/small-and-medium/#what-is-the-difference-between-basic-support-and-premium-support-services" id="trigger-10851058" class="" aria-controls="content-pane-10851058"><h4 class="bold"> What is the difference between basic support and Premium Support Services? </h4></a></span><div class="content" id="content-pane-10851058" aria-labelledby="trigger-10851058" role="region"><div class="content-wrapper"><div id="content-c10851057" class="frame frame-default frame-type-text frame-layout-0 skin-mb-small"><p>Besides free technical support for our business customers with best effort response times we also provide two levels of paid <a href="/us/business/services/premium-support/">ESET Premium Support</a> add-on services with guaranteed SLAs and 24/7 local technical support via trained teams of professionals located across the globe (we speak 28 languages). ESET tech support is also greatly appreciated by our customers as proven by the reviews on peer review platforms (e.g. achieving 9.5 rating out of 10 on <a href="https://www.trustradius.com/products/eset-protect/reviews?qs=support-rating#reviews" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">TrustRadius</a> platform).</p></div></div></div></div><div id="content-c10851060" class="pane "><span class="title"><a href="/us/business/small-and-medium/#what-is-mdr-service-and-do-i-need-it" id="trigger-10851060" class="" aria-controls="content-pane-10851060"><h4 class="bold"> What is MDR Service and do I need it? </h4></a></span><div class="content" id="content-pane-10851060" aria-labelledby="trigger-10851060" role="region"><div class="content-wrapper"><div id="content-c12500028" class="frame frame-default frame-type-text frame-layout-0 skin-mb-small"><p>Managed Detection & Response (MDR) is a cybersecurity service that uses technology and human expertise to monitor your endpoints and company environment and respond to cyber threats 24/7. ESET helps with outsourcing the cybersecurity knowledge by utilizing our proprietary global threat intelligence and provides a superfast MDR service with a 6-minute time to detect and respond on average compared to the 16 hours that this usually takes for the internal security operations teams – SOCs. This means we swiftly identify and block any potential malicious activity in your system. The ESET MDR services fulfill the needs of enterprise-scale organizations and SMB companies from 25 seats as well. Explore our <a href="/us/business/services/managed-detection-and-response/">ESET MDR offering</a> in more detail.</p></div></div></div></div><div id="content-c10851062" class="pane "><span class="title"><a href="/us/business/small-and-medium/#what-is-extended-detection-and-response-and-why-should-i-need-it-on-top-of-standard-cybersecurity" id="trigger-10851062" class="" aria-controls="content-pane-10851062"><h4 class="bold"> What is Extended Detection and Response and why should I need it on top of standard cybersecurity? </h4></a></span><div class="content" id="content-pane-10851062" aria-labelledby="trigger-10851062" role="region"><div class="content-wrapper"><div id="content-c10851061" class="frame frame-default frame-type-text frame-layout-0 skin-mb-small"><p>Today, organizations need increased visibility into their endpoints, devices, and network to ensure that emerging threats, risky employee behavior, and unwanted applications do not risk their profits or reputation. <a href="/us/business/solutions/xdr-extended-detection-and-response/">Extended Detection and Response (XDR)</a> is a relatively new approach to threat detection and response that provides holistic protection against cyberattacks. This requires having an XDR tool implemented in your organization and people – security specialists – to use this tool to detect threats, identify anomalous behavior in your network and realize remediation activities to prevent sophisticated attacks from spreading. ESET provides a cloud-delivered XDR-enabling module ESET Inspect that equips risk managers and incident responders with outstanding threat and system visibility, allowing them to perform fast and in-depth root cause analysis and immediately respond to incidents.</p></div></div></div></div><div id="content-c10851064" class="pane "><span class="title"><a href="/us/business/small-and-medium/#is-there-any-difference-in-offering-for-customer-below-and-above--devices" id="trigger-10851064" class="" aria-controls="content-pane-10851064"><h4 class="bold"> Is there any difference in offering for customer below and above 100 devices? </h4></a></span><div class="content" id="content-pane-10851064" aria-labelledby="trigger-10851064" role="region"><div class="content-wrapper"><div id="content-c10851063" class="frame frame-default frame-type-text frame-layout-0"><p>No. Cybersecurity solutions and <a href="/us/business/protect-platform/">ESET PROTECT Platform</a> capabilities are available to all business customers starting from 5 devices or 25 devices for solutions with the Detection & Response module included. There are, though, subscription tiers or add-ons you can purchase directly online from our website with a limitation of up to 100 devices. If you want to purchase a larger amount of quantity or specific services, please <a href="/us/business/contact-sales/">contact our sales team</a>, who will support you and create a tailor-made offer according to your requirements.</p></div></div></div></div><div id="content-c10851066" class="pane "><span class="title"><a href="/us/business/small-and-medium/#how-should-i-calculate-the-number-of-my-devices-and-what-operating-systems-are-supported" id="trigger-10851066" class="" aria-controls="content-pane-10851066"><h4 class="bold"> How should I calculate the number of my devices and what operating systems are supported? </h4></a></span><div class="content" id="content-pane-10851066" aria-labelledby="trigger-10851066" role="region"><div class="content-wrapper"><div id="content-c12500029" class="frame frame-default frame-type-text frame-layout-0 skin-mb-small"><p>ESET PROTECT subscriptions cover the most popular computer, smartphone tablet, file and mail server operating systems, cloud workloads or cloud applications allowing you to mix and match protection among devices, servers, cloud virtual machines or users in a specific module of the platform without having to purchase additional devices.</p><p>With the Modern Endpoint Protection and Server Security modules we cover operating systems:</p><ul><li>Computers: Windows, Mac, Linux</li><li>Smartphones and tablets: Android, iOS and iPadOS</li><li>File Servers: Windows, Linux</li></ul><p>With the Mobile Threat Defense module we cover additionally extra count of devices with operating systems:</p><ul><li>Smartphones and tablets: Android, iOS and iPadOS</li></ul><p>With the Mail Server Security module we cover operating systems:</p><ul><li>Mail Servers: Exchange or IBM</li></ul><p><strong>With the Cloud Workload Protection module we cover virtual machines in public cloud environments:</strong></p><ul><li>Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform</li><li>OS distributions: Windows, Linux</li></ul><p>With the Cloud Application Protection module we cover users of the platforms (the count is per user, not per device):</p><ul><li>Microsoft 365: Exchange Online, OneDrive, Teams, SharePoint Online</li><li>Google Workspace: Gmail, Google Drive</li></ul><p>E.g. with a 50 devices ESET PROTECT Complete protection purchase you get 50 endpoints (and you can choose the split of the count to your computers, smartphones, file servers and cloud virtual machines), extra 50 mobile devices (as part of the Mobile Threat Defense module), 60 mailboxes and mail servers (with 10 mailboxes extra) within mail server security , 60 users (with 10 users extra) within Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace cloud services.</p></div></div></div></div><div id="content-c10851068" class="pane "><span class="title"><a frame-type-text frame-layout-0"><p>All supported integrations and APIs are listed on a <a href="/us/business/partner/integration/">our Integration marketplace</a>. To achieve this we cooperate with various vendors across the industry, covering XDR, Threat Intelligence, SIEM, SOAR, security services (MDR), and we also serve MSPs with RMM and PSA Integrations.</p><p>In case a vendor is not listed, it is still very convenient to integrate ESET solutions via APIs. We pay close attention to the needs of businesses and therefore our APIs are easy to implement – for example, all of them are documented in detailed in Swagger.       if (!isMobileViewport()) return;
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {

        openTemporarily(3500);
      }

        sessionStorage.setItem('gpcAutoShown', '1');

          openTemporarily(2500);

Cloud or On-prem deployment of ESET PROTECT Platform? ESET PROTECT Platform provides freedom of choice for both cloud and on-prem deployments. The widest range of benefits is provided via cloud deployments. Cloud deployment enables anywhere / anytime access to all company cybersecurity data via any online connected device. It will be able to connect and report, without the need to resolve networking issues, e.g. VPNs. Compared to on-prem deployment, cloud deployment provides always up-to-date, secured information. The environment is maintained by ESET, relieving your IT department to focus on your core business. Cloud deployment of ESET PROTECT solution tiers puts ESET PROTECT Platform’s full potential at your fingertips. When should I consider purchasing add-on? ESET provides several tiers of subscriptions (packages) to the ESET PROTECT Platform with capabilities included based on your needs and level of protection required. An add-on is useful and efficient to purchase in case of a specific demand or area to cover, when you do not necessarily need a higher-tier subscription (package) with all modules included. E.g. If you want to extend the data security just by adding a multi-factor authentication protection layer you can purchase ESET Secure Authentication as an add-on module without the need to purchase the whole ESET PROTECT Elite subscription tier. However, we suggest you always compare and consider the benefits of purchasing an add-on solution versus buying a full subscription package that usually comes with better value for the price offered. Contact our sales experts who will guide you through our offering and prepare an offer tailored to your needs. I want to protect my mobile devices. How should I proceed? If you want to protect only your mobile devices, purchase ESET Mobile Threat Defense add-on solution and enroll all your Android, iOS or iPad OS devices via ESET PROTECT Platform. But if you need combined protection for desktop and mobile devices, you better purchase any of the ESET PROTECT subscriptions where protection of mobile devices is included by default. In the subscriptions starting from ESET PROTECT Advanced you have an extra benefit of having Mobile Threat Defense included with 1:1 ratio, that means if you buy 100 seat subscription to the ESET PROTECT Advanced solution, you get protection for 100 endpoints (and you can choose if you use it for laptops, PCs or mobiles) + extra protection for 100 mobile devices on top. Is ESET PROTECT Entry sufficient to keep me safe? ESET PROTECT Entry is a tier that provides an essential level of protection with proven and very effective prevention layer over your endpoints including next-generation antivirus , device control, anti-phishing and much more. Compared to other vendors, our entry solution offers not just great malware prevention ( see our results in tests ) but also includes other additional features such as Device control, Anti-phishing and more, that can be greatly utilized by organizations of all sizes to keep your business safe . I am concerned about email threats. What solution should I choose? The smartest and the most effective option is to go for ESET PROTECT Complete subscription tier with both on-prem mail security for Exchange or IBM servers and cloud app protection for Exchange Online (Microsoft 365) or Gmail (Google Workspace) included. This solution provides an extra layer of mail protection with advanced threat defense technology embedded. However, our core NGAV module Endpoint Security also includes features such as Anti-phishing that help preventing attacks from the email threat vector. And this module is included from the entry level subscription ESET PROTECT Entry. Is there any free support included? Yes, ESET has free technical support for our business customers included to help with troubleshooting of the deployed ESET solutions. Within the free support we provide best effort response times during standard business hours and working week. To achieve full 24/7 instant tech support and services like e.g. health check, ESET provides additional paid Premium Support services. What is the difference between basic support and Premium Support Services? Besides free technical support for our business customers with best effort response times we also provide two levels of paid ESET Premium Support add-on services with guaranteed SLAs and 24/7 local technical support via trained teams of professionals located across the globe (we speak 28 languages). ESET tech support is also greatly appreciated by our customers as proven by the reviews on peer review platforms (e.g. achieving 9.5 rating out of 10 on TrustRadius platform). What is MDR Service and do I need it? Managed Detection & Response (MDR) is a cybersecurity service that uses technology and human expertise to monitor your endpoints and company environment and respond to cyber threats 24/7. ESET helps with outsourcing the cybersecurity knowledge by utilizing our proprietary global threat intelligence and provides a superfast MDR service with a 6-minute time to detect and respond on average compared to the 16 hours that this usually takes for the internal security operations teams – SOCs. This means we swiftly identify and block any potential malicious activity in your system. The ESET MDR services fulfill the needs of enterprise-scale organizations and SMB companies from 25 seats as well. Explore our ESET MDR offering in more detail. What is Extended Detection and Response and why should I need it on top of standard cybersecurity? Today, organizations need increased visibility into their endpoints, devices, and network to ensure that emerging threats, risky employee behavior, and unwanted applications do not risk their profits or reputation. Extended Detection and Response (XDR) is a relatively new approach to threat detection and response that provides holistic protection against cyberattacks. This requires having an XDR tool implemented in your organization and people – security specialists – to use this tool to detect threats, identify anomalous behavior in your network and realize remediation activities to prevent sophisticated attacks from spreading. ESET provides a cloud-delivered XDR-enabling module ESET Inspect that equips risk managers and incident responders with outstanding threat and system visibility, allowing them to perform fast and in-depth root cause analysis and immediately respond to incidents. Is there any difference in offering for customer below and above 100 devices? No. Cybersecurity solutions and ESET PROTECT Platform capabilities are available to all business customers starting from 5 devices or 25 devices for solutions with the Detection & Response module included. There are, though, subscription tiers or add-ons you can purchase directly online from our website with a limitation of up to 100 devices. If you want to purchase a larger amount of quantity or specific services, please contact our sales team , who will support you and create a tailor-made offer according to your requirements. How should I calculate the number of my devices and what operating systems are supported? ESET PROTECT subscriptions cover the most popular computer, smartphone tablet, file and mail server operating systems, cloud workloads or cloud applications allowing you to mix and match protection among devices, servers, cloud virtual machines or users in a specific module of the platform without having to purchase additional devices. With the Modern Endpoint Protection and Server Security modules we cover operating systems: Computers: Windows, Mac, Linux Smartphones and tablets: Android, iOS and iPadOS File Servers: Windows, Linux With the Mobile Threat Defense module we cover additionally extra count of devices with operating systems: Smartphones and tablets: Android, iOS and iPadOS With the Mail Server Security module we cover operating systems: Mail Servers: Exchange or IBM With the Cloud Workload Protection module we cover virtual machines in public cloud environments: Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform OS distributions: Windows, Linux With the Cloud Application Protection module we cover users of the platforms (the count is per user, not per device): Microsoft 365: Exchange Online, OneDrive, Teams, SharePoint Online Google Workspace: Gmail, Google Drive E.g. with a 50 devices ESET PROTECT Complete protection purchase you get 50 endpoints (and you can choose the split of the count to your computers, smartphones, file servers and cloud virtual machines), extra 50 mobile devices (as part of the Mobile Threat Defense module), 60 mailboxes and mail servers (with 10 mailboxes extra) within mail server security , 60 users (with 10 users extra) within Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace cloud services. What Integrations are supported? All supported integrations and APIs are listed on a our Integration marketplace . The list of integration partners is growing rapidly, as we are dedicated to provide integrations with major cybersecurity vendors. To achieve this we cooperate with various vendors across the industry, covering XDR, Threat Intelligence, SIEM, SOAR, security services (MDR), and we also serve MSPs with RMM and PSA Integrations. In case a vendor is not listed, it is still very convenient to integrate ESET solutions via APIs. We pay close attention to the needs of businesses and therefore our APIs are easy to implement – for example, all of them are documented in detailed in Swagger. For more, check here . Our consumer security product line has evolved.

ESET Internet Security, ESET Cyber Security, ESET Cyber Security Pro and ESET Smart Security Premium are now part of our all-in-one protection plans, which also feature new privacy and identity enhancements. If you currently have a subscription for either of these products, click on the respective product name to learn more about your download, renew and upgrade options.

FAQs For Home Products

How can I renew, add more devices or modify my current subsciption?

You can renew, enlarge or upgrade your subscription at any time.

  1. Start by logging into eStore account using your Activation key or License key.
  2. To renew your subscription, select the “Extend” option and adjust the period or number of devices you’d like to cover.
  3. If you want to add additional devices keeping the original expiration date, select “Enlarge” and adjust number of devices you’d like to cover. We’ll match the expiry date and calculate the pro-rated price for your extra devices.
  4. Check your inbox for a confirmation email and further installation instructions.

Please note, that if you're currently using ESET Internet Security, ESET Cyber Security, ESET Cyber Security Pro or ESET Smart Security Premium, you’ll be asked to Convert your license to the respective ESET HOME Security all-in-one protection plan during each of these transactions.

If these options are not present in your account, it’s likely that your license has already expired. If this is the case, we recommend purchasing a new all-in-one protection plan.

How do I retrieve my subscription information?

If you have lost or forgotten your subscription information (username, password, or activation key), you can have it resent to your email address. Simply click here and insert enter the email address you originally used to register or activate your ESET subscription.

How do I download and install ESET after purchase?

You can install ESET by following these simple steps:

  1. Uninstall any previously installed antivirus software on your system.
  2. Click on the “GET STARTED” button on this page and create or login to your ESET HOME.
  3. Install ESET on your devices by clicking on "Protect device" button. In case you need to add your subscription first, use the “Add subscription” button.
  4. Choose your operating system and download the installer file.
  5. Install by following on-screen instructions.

Additional details regarding product installation and activation can be found here.

How do I transfer my ESET subscription to a new computer or device?

  1. Uninstall ESET from your old device. If your old device is not working, disconnect the device from your subscription via ESET HOME.
  2. Download and install your ESET product on your new computer or mobile device. 

Additional details regarding transferring your subscription can be found here. 

How do I activate my retail product subscription?

If you have purchased a boxed ESET solution, you can activate it here.

How do I know if my ESET product has all the new features available?

All new features are available to customers using ESET HOME Security Essential, Premium or Ultimate subscription or ESET Internet Security or ESET Smart Security Premium product version 17 or higher. You can check which ESET subscription are you currently using here

Do I need to reinstall after renewing?

No, if you renewed your subscription you do not have to reinstall on the same computer. No further action is required for home users after renewal.

Some home users might experience a brief delay before the expiration date is updated and program module updates are downloaded. Your virus protection will remain active and your computer will be secure during this time.

How can I cancel my automatic renewal?

Auto-renew is continuous, unless you turn it off after your purchase, via your account. Turning off auto-renew will not cancel your subscription—your ESET protection will continue until it expires. We will notify you before expiration so that you may renew manually.

You may cancel automatic renewal at any time.  

  1. Start by logging into your account using your License key or License ID.
  2. Proceed to the Subscription Management page, where you may use the “Auto-Renewal” slider to cancel the renewal of your subscription.
  3. Confirm your selection to renew manually. 

I just renewed, but my old expiration date is still displayed in the program—why?

Users may experience a brief delay before the expiration date is updated and program updates are downloaded. Your virus protection will remain active, and your computer will be secure. If you renew before your expiration date, your new expiration date will not take effect until your original expiration date passes. If more than 24h pass and the subscription is still showing as not updated, activate your product again with your activation key.

I never received the subscription email containing my Username and Password/Activation Key – what can I do?

If you do not receive an email from ESET within 24 hours of purchasing or activation, see below for suggested actions to take: 

  • Check your spam and secondary inbox folders. 
  • Gmail users: Look in the Promotions folder. 
  • Visit the Lost License page to have your ESET-issued Username and License Key resent.  

If you still do not receive either message, your email address may have been misspelled during the purchase process. In this case, complete a technical support request. 

How do I upgrade my ESET Windows home product to the latest version?

  1. Uninstall your current ESET product.  
  2. Download the installation file of the latest version of ESET product here.  
  3. Double-click the file to open ESET Live Installer. 
  4. Follow the on-screen instructions to install and activate your ESET product.  

More details here. 

Can I still use and renew ESET Internet Security, ESET Cyber Security or ESET Smart Security Premium?

If you currently have an active ESET Internet Security, ESET Cyber Security or ESET Smart Security Premium subscription, it will continue to provide the familiar protection until it expires. No immediate action is required on your part. When it's time for renewal, you will be given the option to convert your license to the respective ESET HOME Security subscription tier. This ensures the continuity of your product and protection. This transition will not result in the loss of any features.

Please note that to activate your protection using ESET HOME Security Essential, Premium or Ultimate, you need to connect your device to your ESET HOME account. You can easily do this by following these simple steps.

FAQs For Business Products

How do I download the installation file for my business product?

The recommended way is to do it via ESET PROTECT. Managing your endpoints centrally saves time, is more efficient and provides 24/7 peace of mind. Our security management console is included free with your subscription.

If you prefer to download manually, you can download the installation file on this page. 

Can I upgrade or update my product to the latest version?

All products installed via cloud console are updated automatically.

If you want to upgrade or update your business software to the latest version, you can do so on this page. Choose your business product and follow the given instructions. 

How do I renew, upgrade or add devices to my business subscription?

You can renew your subscription online via your subscription account, where you can renew, upgrade, or add devices to your current business subscription.

  1. Start by logging into your account using your License key or License ID.
  2. To renew your subscription, select the “Extend” option and adjust the period or number of devices you’d like to cover.
  3. If you want to add additional devices keeping the original expiration date, select “Enlarge” and adjust number of devices you’d like to cover. We’ll match the expiry date and calculate the pro-rated price for your extra devices. 

If these options are not present in your account, it’s likely that your subscription has already expired. If this is the case, we recommend purchasing a new subscription here. 

How can I extend or upgrade my subscription before renewal period?

ESET does not currently offer a license extension program. However, you can renew up to 90 days before your license expires. If you decide to renew before your expiration date, your new expiration date will not take effect until your original expiration date passes.

Example: If you renew on the 15th of this month and your expiration date is not until the 1st of next month, your new expiration date will not take effect until the 1st of next month.

How can I set up my console and manage my devices on-premises?

On-premise management guide is available step-by-step on this page.

How can I log into Managed Service Provider Administrator?

You can log in and enjoy the freedom of creating customer sites and ordering monthly MSP subscriptions of ESET solutions for your customers. ESET MSP Administrator offers: 

  • Complete self-service 
  • Daily billing, monthly invoicing 
  • Immediate order fulfilments 
  • Detailed, live usage reporting 

*Note: ESET MSP Administrator is set to be replaced by ESET PROTECT Hub. Learn more about the transition.

Where can I manage my business devices?

Thanks to ESET PROTECT you can log into your console and manage your devices from anywhere. ESET PROTECT is your main dashboard for managing security across your entire organization. Console provides you with: 

  • Instant visibility of network security 
  • Automated resolution of security incidents 
  • Manage endpoints, servers and mobiles 
  • Full-disk encryption and cloud sandbox management 
  • Flexible reporting and configuration with preset policy templates

Uninstall your current ESET product.   Download the installation file of the latest version of ESET product here .   Double-click the file to open ESET Live Installer.  Follow the on-screen instructions to install and activate your ESET product.   More details here .  Can I still use and renew ESET Internet Security, ESET Cyber Security or ESET Smart Security Premium? If you currently have an active ESET Internet Security, ESET Cyber Security or ESET Smart Security Premium subscription, it will continue to provide the familiar protection until it expires. No immediate action is required on your part. When it's time for renewal, you will be given the option to convert your license to the respective ESET HOME Security subscription tier. This ensures the continuity of your product and protection. This transition will not result in the loss of any features. Please note that to activate your protection using ESET HOME Security Essential, Premium or Ultimate, you need to connect your device to your ESET HOME account. You can easily do this by following these simple steps . FAQs For Business Products How do I download the installation file for my business product? The recommended way is to do it via ESET PROTECT . Managing your endpoints centrally saves time, is more efficient and provides 24/7 peace of mind. Our security management console is included free with your subscription. If you prefer to download manually, you can download the installation file on this page .  Can I upgrade or update my product to the latest version? All products installed via cloud console are updated automatically. If you want to upgrade or update your business software to the latest version, you can do so on this page . Choose your business product and follow the given instructions.  How do I renew, upgrade or add devices to my business subscription? You can renew your subscription online via your subscription account, where you can renew, upgrade, or add devices to your current business subscription. Start by logging into your account using your License key or License ID. To renew your subscription, select the “Extend” option and adjust the period or number of devices you’d like to cover. If you want to add additional devices keeping the original expiration date, select “Enlarge” and adjust number of devices you’d like to cover. We’ll match the expiry date and calculate the pro-rated price for your extra devices.  If these options are not present in your account, it’s likely that your subscription has already expired. If this is the case, we recommend purchasing a new subscription here .  How can I extend or upgrade my subscription before renewal period? ESET does not currently offer a license extension program. However, you can renew up to 90 days before your license expires. If you decide to renew before your expiration date, your new expiration date will not take effect until your original expiration date passes. Example: If you renew on the 15th of this month and your expiration date is not until the 1st of next month, your new expiration date will not take effect until the 1st of next month. You can log in and enjoy the freedom of creating customer sites and ordering monthly MSP subscriptions of ESET solutions for your customers.
